```lean
intro a
apply measurable_singularity
intros s hs
obtain ⟨t, ht, h1, h2⟩ := ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.singularPart_split (κ a) (η a)
have h3 : MeasurableSet t := ht
have h4 : MeasurableSet (s ∩ t) := by apply measurable_set_inter; exact ⟨hs, h3⟩
have h5 : ∀ᵐ x ∈ s ∩ t, (κ a).measure x = 0 := by rw [measurable_set_mk_left, measurable_set_inter, h4]; exact h1
have h6 : ∀ᵐ x ∈ s ∩ t, (η a).measure x = 0 := by rw [measurable_set_mk_left, measurable_set_inter, h4]; exact h2
have h7 : ∀ᵐ x ∈ s ∩ t, (κ a).measure x = (η a).measure x := by rw [h5, h6]; exact measure_eq_zero_measure_zero
exact h7
```
